qreal distanceThreshold

Detailed Description

Defines a style for a MPanRecognizerStyle class.

This class defines the default threshold values that are used by pan gesture recognizers.

Property Documentation

qreal MPanRecognizerStyle::distanceThreshold [read, write]

Distance threshold which is used to check if the pointer was moved far enough to recognize pan gesture.
